title: Tradeoffs Between Alignment and Helpfulness in Language Models with Steering Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to biased and unbiased statements from the StereoSet dataset by using a binary behavior scoring function (+1 for agreeing, -1 for disagreeing with a racist statement) to calculate the 'behavior expectation' (the difference in probabilities of agreeing vs. disagreeing) as representation engineering steering vectors are applied.
